ops.title: watch service crash-loops on 0.19.0: StoreSchema.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'extra_ddl'
ops.description: Found during the 2026-07-25/26 fleet stabilization machine sweeps (recorded on daemonkit cc-notes task fc39f885): the `com.cc-steer.watch` launchd job is in a KeepAlive crash loop with `TypeError: StoreSchema.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'extra_ddl'` — a cc-steer 0.19.0 packaging bug (StoreSchema signature drift against its pinned dependencies). `com.cc-steer.pipeline` and `.retrain` are fine. Explicitly UNRELATED to the daemonkit/synckit incident — filed separately by design; do not fold into the fleet-repair work. The installed 0.19.0 predates the drift fix or its deps moved under it; either bump the pins and cut a release or fix the call site.

ops.text: com.cc-steer.watch runs exit-0 under launchd on the affected machine after the fix
the StoreSchema signature drift between cc-steer 0.19.0 and its pinned deps is reconciled (pin bump or code fix) with a regression test
